title: Manifest applies: the provisioner creates a matching live server and fires hetznerServerProvisioned
asA: developer whose project provisions a Hetzner Cloud VM from git-managed manifests
iWant: applying the provisioner to read each manifest under hetzner/servers/, create a matching live Hetzner Cloud server, and emit hetznerServerProvisioned with id, primaryIpv4, location and serverType
soThat: the manifest is the source of truth for what actually exists in the project

acceptanceCriteria.description: The real-account-throwaway-server-provision probe (accountBound: true, skipped without CI_HAS_HETZNER_ACCOUNT) applies the ci-throwaway.json manifest via provision.mjs, asserts (a) hcloud server list --output json shows the new server whose id is written to the fixture scratch file, (b) hetznerServerProvisioned fired with id, primaryIpv4, location=fsn1, serverType=cx23; teardown via destroy.mjs runs regardless of probe verdict.

Provisioner failure surfaces (upstream non-2xx). Given the hetzner API returns a non-2xx response (for example 429 rate-limited on the account) during a createServer call, when provision.mjs runs, then the facade catches the failure, emits provisionerFailed with { verb: "createServer", apiStatus, retryable: boolean } on the event sink, no hetznerServerProvisioned fires, and no orphan server survives on the account after the run.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the hetzner API returns 429 on createServer
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade emits provisionerFailed with { verb, apiStatus, retryable }; no hetznerServerProvisioned fires; no orphan server survives after the run

acceptanceCriteria.description: Repeat-apply idempotency. Given a manifest already applied once and matching a live server on the account, when provision.mjs runs the same manifest a second time, then the facade emits no second hetznerServerProvisioned, the run exits zero, and the live server id remains unchanged; a subsequent destroy tears the single server down.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest already applied once against a live matching server
acceptanceCriteria.when: provision.mjs runs the same manifest again
acceptanceCriteria.then: no second hetznerServerProvisioned fires; the run exits zero; the live server id remains unchanged
